description: This file defines the BedrockRuntimeClient class, which is a PHP client for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Runtime service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as applyGuardrail, converse, getAsyncInvoke, invokeModel, and others, many of which have asynchronous variants.

classes.name: BedrockRuntimeClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for Amazon Bedrock Runtime API, extending AwsClient to provide methods for interacting with the service.

methods.name: applyGuardrail
methods.description: Executes the applyGuardrail operation on the Amazon Bedrock Runtime service.

methods.name: invokeModelWithResponseStream
methods.description: Invokes a model with response streaming.

methods.name: invokeModelWithResponseStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a model with response streaming.
